title: New world — keep who you are
kicker: Quests, failure, memory · prestige of place
loopLine: Level up and power · Farm / hunt / defend
hook: **You keep who you are. You lose where you were.** Ending a world is progression — not a prestige wipe of the summoner.

blindSpots.meaning: Starting another map after win or lose. Roster, souls, and essence come with you; loam and that map’s holdings do not.
The rule is real product law in the guide. Surfaces that start/end worlds may still feel thin — the promise is the keep/lose split.
The rejected idea that a new world deletes your summoner power. This game does not do that.
World stock and failed-map holdings die with the place. They never bank.

alsoTrue: Win: take Zomboss’s fortress. Lose: the homeworld falls.
Same roster, same souls, same essence — whichever world you open next.

sections.title: What it is
paras: Ending one world and starting another *is* the progression loop.
Identity (roster, souls, essence, Dave’s power) banks. Place (loam, holdings) resets with the map.

rows: Holdings of the failed or finished map

sections.note: Status is Shipped (fiction) — the law holds even when world-end chrome is thin.

sections.title: Why it exists
paras: Without a keep/lose split, empire play either wipes your summoner (punishing) or banks forever-ground (boring).
You keep who you are so power and roster mean something across maps. You lose where you were so holdings stay a real fight.
diagram: +->  keep: roster, souls, essence, Dave power

groups.title: Win and lose
groups.intro: Defined on The game — fortress vs homeworld.
steps: Play toward Zomboss’s fortress — or fall defending the homeworld.
When a world ends, expect banked identity and a fresh place.
Open Chronicle / Creatures to confirm who you still are.
groups.note: Exact end-of-world UI may be thin; the keep/lose rule is the teachable core.

doSteps: Check that souls and essence are player banks — loam is not.
Treat a future new-world start as prestige of place, not a summoner delete.
doNote: Stop when new world ≠ soft reset of Dave. Related: [loam](loam), [souls](souls).

mixUps.q: Does a new world delete my demons?
mixUps.a: No. Roster banks. You lose the map’s holdings and loam.
No. Souls and essence bank across worlds.

mixUps.q: Is this a paid prestige layer?
mixUps.a: No. Play is local with no payments — new world is the place loop.
The keep/lose law is product-real; world-end presentation can still feel thin.
